SLA maintenance and support

Your system is not left alone after launch: response times in the contract, updates and fixes every month. With Qilich, the basic plan costs UZS 6–18.5 mln per month; work starts within 1–2 weeks.

Start
1–2 weeks

Who it is for
Any business
Integrations
  • Telegram

What you get

Basic plan
  • Basic plan: support in Tashkent business hours
  • Response within 4 working hours on critical issues
  • Monitoring
  • Security updates
  • 10–20 hours of fixes a month
  • Monthly report
Extended plan
  • Extended plan: 24/7 for critical incidents with a 30–60 minute response
  • A named engineer
  • Small improvements every month
  • Quarterly kaizen review
  • On-call for your peak events
Please note

For systems built by another team we start with a short audit.

What we need from you

  • The project's code and documents
  • Access rights
  • A contact person

Questions

How much does “SLA maintenance and support” cost per month?
At Qilich the basic plan costs $500–1,500 (UZS 6–18.5 mln) per month, the extended plan $2,000–6,000 (UZS 24–73 mln) per month. The exact price depends on the scope of work.
How soon can “SLA maintenance and support” start?
Qilich starts within 1–2 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “SLA maintenance and support”?
The project's code and documents, access rights, a contact person.

Prefer to talk? Call +998 97 270 70 07 or send Qilich an enquiry.
